meta.homeTitle: Open Generative AI — Free AI Image & Video Studio
meta.homeDescription: Generate AI images and videos with 200+ models. One OWeb account, your MuAPI key, workspace-scoped studio.

home.headline: Create with AI, from image to cinema
home.subhead: A full creative studio in your browser — Flux, Kling, Veo, Wan, and 200+ models. Same sign-in as OWeb. Bring your own MuAPI key.

items.title: Image & layers
items.body: Generate, edit, and composite with modern diffusion and editing models.

items.title: Video & cinema
items.body: Text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, and cinematic shots.

items.title: Voice & sync
items.body: Lip sync, audio tools, and marketing-ready ad variations.

items.title: Agents & workflows
items.body: Automate multi-step creative pipelines without leaving the studio.

items.title: Sign in with OWeb
items.body: Use your existing OneID — no second password to remember.

items.title: Add your MuAPI key
items.body: Keys stay in your browser per workspace. You control spend and access.

items.title: Create in the studio
items.body: Pick a tool tab, choose a model, and generate — results stay in your session.

cta.title: Ready to create?
cta.body: Open the studio dashboard or sign in to sync your OWeb workspace.
cta.signedIn: Continue where you left off in the studio.
cta.signedOut: Sign in with the same account you use on OWeb.

featuresPage.headline: Built for serious creative work
